name: review-story
description: Narrated code reviews with synchronized diagrams and source.

scripts.build: python3 skills/review-story/scripts/build.py examples/checkout/review.json --audio examples/checkout/audio --out docs/review.html --source-pages docs/source/checkout --audio-format mp3 && python3 scripts/add-demo-intro.py docs/review.html --home docs/index.html
scripts.build:starter: python3 skills/review-story/scripts/build.py examples/catalog/review.json --audio examples/catalog/audio --out docs/catalog.html --source-pages docs/source
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.build:extended: python3 skills/review-story/scripts/build.py examples/notices/review.json --audio examples/notices/audio --out docs/notices.html --source-pages docs/source --audio-format mp3
